blocks.caption: Michelin Guide Thailand 2026 — by the numbers

blocks.text: When the next guide is announced

blocks.html:
Michelin rolls out a new Thailand edition late each year. The one badged "2026" was actually revealed in late 2025, so on the same rhythm the "2027" edition should land around November or December 2026.

There's no official date yet, and no 2027 restaurant list exists. If you want to book a starred table early, watch the late-year window closely, since the popular rooms fill fast once the list drops.

blocks.text: How the tiers work: stars, Bib, Green, Selected

blocks.html:
Michelin stars reward cooking alone. One star means a very good restaurant in its category, two stars means worth a detour, and three stars means worth a special journey just for that meal.

Bib Gourmand flags great food at a friendly price. The Green Star goes to kitchens serious about sustainability, from sourcing to their environmental footprint. Selected restaurants are inspector-recommended spots that haven't earned a star or Bib. All of them live in the same guide.

The headline of the 2026 edition was Sorn becoming the first Thai restaurant to reach three stars. That brings Thailand to two three-star tables, the other being Sühring.

Across the 2026 edition there are 2 three-star, 8 two-star, and 33 one-star restaurants, while the value-focused Bib Gourmand list grew to 137 spots. That growth says Michelin is leaning into affordable, everyday eating, not just fine dining.

Based on the recent direction, two things are worth tracking: expansion into new provinces beyond the established cities, and the number of Green Stars, which sat at 5 in the 2026 edition and could climb as sustainability stays front of mind.

Which restaurants gain or shift stars in 2027 is genuinely unknown until announcement day. We'll update this page the moment Michelin reveals the new edition.

faq.q: When will the 2027 Michelin Guide Thailand be announced?
faq.a: There's no official date yet, but Michelin typically unveils a new edition late in the year. The 2026 edition was announced in late 2025, so the 2027 edition is expected around November to December 2026.

faq.q: How many three-star restaurants does Thailand have right now?
faq.a: The 2026 edition has two three-star restaurants: Sorn, the first Thai restaurant to earn three stars, and Sühring.

faq.q: How many starred and Bib restaurants are in the 2026 edition?
faq.a: There are 2 three-star, 8 two-star, and 33 one-star restaurants, plus 137 Bib Gourmand, 5 Green Star, and 305 Selected restaurants.

faq.q: What's the difference between a Bib Gourmand and a Michelin star?
faq.a: Stars reward cooking quality, while a Bib Gourmand highlights great food at an affordable price. They're separate recognitions, not competing rankings.
The Green Star recognizes restaurants committed to sustainability, from sourcing to environmental practices. The 2026 edition awarded 5 of them.

faq.q: Is there a list of restaurants that will get stars in 2027?
faq.a: No. The 2027 results will only be known when Michelin announces the edition in late 2026. No restaurant has been confirmed for the next edition yet.
